players.product: Turnkey custom-chip (ASIC) design and mass-production services for AI/data-processing chips, plus licensed GPU, GPGPU, NPU and VPU processor IP

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: revenue RMB 3,152,444,709.71 (RMB 31.52 hundred million), up 35.77%; H2 2025 revenue RMB 21.79 hundred million, up 123.73% on H1 2025 and 56.75% on H2 2024. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 389,670,345.85, Q2 RMB 584,129,488.35, Q3 RMB 1,280,736,930.52, Q4 RMB 897,907,944.99. By business: mass production RMB 14.90 hundred million (+73.98%, gross margin 18.14%), chip design RMB 8.77 hundred million (+20.94%, gross margin 14.22%), IP licence fees RMB 6.71 hundred million (+6.07%, gross margin 85.77%), royalties RMB 1.11 hundred million (+7.57%); turnkey custom-chip business RMB 23.66 hundred million (75.06% of revenue, gross margin 16.69%), IP licensing RMB 7.82 hundred million (24.81%). Gross profit RMB 10.78 hundred million (+16.43%); gross margin 34.19%, down 5.68 points on revenue mix. Net profit attributable to shareholders RMB -5.28 hundred million (RMB -4.86 hundred million excluding share-based payment), net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB -6.14 hundred million; the company says losses are narrowing.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue RMB 31.52 hundred million (+35.77%); mass production RMB 14.90 hundred million (+73.98%); gross margin 34.19%; net profit RMB -5.28 hundred million

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 revenue mix (annual report): AI-compute-related revenue was 64.43% of revenue, up from 55.79% in 2024. Data-processing applications revenue RMB 10.79 hundred million, up 95.35%, 34.22% of revenue (up 10.44 points); consumer electronics RMB 6.76 hundred million (21.45%) and IoT RMB 6.59 hundred million (20.91%). Data processing was 34.72% of turnkey custom-chip revenue and 32.87% of IP licensing revenue. Domestic revenue RMB 21.27 hundred million (+46.44%, 67.49% of revenue); overseas RMB 10.25 hundred million (+17.94%, 32.51%). Revenue from system vendors, large internet companies, cloud service providers and carmakers RMB 12.89 hundred million, about 40% of revenue and above 30% for five consecutive years. The company says customers it serves include Samsung, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Baidu, Tencent and Alibaba, and that seven of the top ten cloud service providers in 2025 used its IP and technical services. It added 19 IP licensing customers (over 460 cumulative) and 17 turnkey customers (nearly 350 cumulative) in 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: AI-compute revenue 64.43% of 2025 revenue (55.79% in 2024); data processing RMB 10.79 hundred million (+95.35%)

quarterly_data.signal: Orders (2025 annual report): new orders signed were RMB 11.82 hundred million in Q2 2025, RMB 15.93 hundred million in Q3 and RMB 27.11 hundred million in Q4 (Q4 up 70.17% on Q3), three consecutive quarterly records. Full-year 2025 new orders RMB 59.60 hundred million, up 103.41%; AI-compute-related orders over 73% and data-processing orders over 50%, mainly cloud AI ASICs and IP. Mass-production new orders RMB 35.47 hundred million, up 194.25%, with more than RMB 22 hundred million in Q4 2025 alone. Order backlog at end-2025 was RMB 50.75 hundred million, up 54.45% from RMB 32.86 hundred million at end-Q3, high for nine consecutive quarters: chip design backlog RMB 16.62 hundred million and mass-production backlog RMB 30.78 hundred million; over 80% is expected to convert within one year and nearly 60% is data-processing orders, mainly cloud AI ASICs and IP. Contract liabilities rose 107.41% to RMB 1,258,496,354.53 on billed-but-unrecognised revenue and advance payments.
quarterly_data.figure: Backlog RMB 50.75 hundred million at end-2025 (+54.45% QoQ); 2025 new orders RMB 59.60 hundred million (+103.41%)

quarterly_data.signal: Design and mass-production operations (2025 annual report): 28nm-and-below nodes were 94.31% of chip design revenue, 14nm-and-below 78.17% and 7nm-and-below 69.42%; AI-compute-related design revenue was RMB 6.37 hundred million, about 73% of design revenue. 104 chip design projects were in execution at year end (19 more than a year earlier), 24.04% of them at 7nm and below. 114 chips contributed mass-production revenue in 2025, with 48 more existing design projects awaiting mass production; mass-production shipments were 81,186 wafers (8-inch equivalent), up 24.90%. Several 5nm SoC projects taped out right first time and are in mass production, a 4nm SoC has taped out and several 5nm/4nm turnkey projects are in execution. It provides 5nm automotive-process autonomous-driving chip customisation for a well-known new-energy carmaker and turnkey AR-glasses chip customisation for a well-known international internet company.
quarterly_data.figure: 104 design projects; 114 chips in mass production; shipments 81,186 wafers (8-inch equivalent, +24.90%)

quarterly_data.signal: Top five customers were 45.51% of 2025 sales (RMB 143,434.10 ten-thousand); the largest 15.99%, the second 15.44%, then 5.80%, 4.87% and 3.41%; names not disclosed; no related-party sales among them; customers three and five are new to the top five.
quarterly_data.figure: top five customers 45.51% of 2025 sales; largest 15.99%

quarterly_data.signal: Top five suppliers were 67.72% of 2025 purchases (RMB 129,761.62 ten-thousand); the largest 28.50%, then 16.77%, 9.18%, 6.86% and 6.41%; names not disclosed; no related-party purchases; supplier five is new to the top five. Prepayments rose 624.78% to RMB 467,228,533.99, mainly wafer prepayments to some mass-production suppliers as mass-production business grew; prepayments older than one year were mainly paid to suppliers to reserve capacity, and the largest prepayee held 66.49% of the balance. The company says it is neutral between foundries and packaging houses, has worked with most of them for over 10 or 15 years, and that suppliers reserve capacity for it based on historical cooperation.
quarterly_data.figure: top five suppliers 67.72% of 2025 purchases; largest 28.50%; prepayments RMB 467,228,533.99 (+624.78%)

quarterly_data.signal: R&D (2025 annual report): R&D investment RMB 1,348,727,862.52, up 8.13%, 42.78% of revenue (53.72% in 2024; the company says the ratio fell as R&D resources moved into customer projects with order growth), 2.67% capitalised; 1,839 R&D staff, 89.40% of employees. In-progress projects with total planned investment of RMB 305,046.86 ten-thousand include a high-performance GPU for data center and GPU-AI computing (RMB 58,321.46 ten-thousand; hardware design complete, verification 90% done; targets 16~32 TFLOPs FP32, 40~240 TFLOPs FP8, Tensor core, CUDA 9.0 and CUDA 12.0 support) and an NPU for data center and edge-server AIGC (RMB 32,550.13 ten-thousand; single-core 0.5 to 200 TOPS, INT4/INT8/FP8/FP16/BF16). Interface IP: its UCIe PHY is silicon-verified at 14nm and 4nm, the UCIe controller plus PHY subsystem is silicon-verified with a customer project tape-out due this year, and an automotive-grade UCIe PHY completed tape-out in Q1.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 1,348,727,862.52 (+8.13%), 42.78% of revenue; data-center GPU project RMB 58,321.46 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Raised-fund projects (2025 annual report): the Chiplet solution platform R&D project for AIGC and smart mobility (planned RMB 107,158.50 ten-thousand, 26.93% invested at end-2025) and the next-generation IP R&D and industrialisation project for AIGC, graphics and similar uses (planned RMB 70,867.71 ten-thousand, 39.59% invested) are both expected to reach intended use in April 2029. The company says the Chiplet project lets it move from IP licensing to also becoming a Chiplet supplier for data center and smart-mobility markets.
quarterly_data.figure: Chiplet platform project RMB 107,158.50 ten-thousand (26.93% invested); both projects due April 2029

quarterly_data.signal: Company plan (2025 annual report): in 2026 VeriSilicon will keep deepening the cloud AI ASIC market while focusing on edge AI ASICs (AI phones, AI PCs, smart mobility, AI glasses, AI toys), push Chiplet solutions toward scaled deployment in AIGC big-data processing and smart mobility using its UCIe PHY IP and 2.5D/CoWoS, 3D stacking and panel-level packaging experience, and accelerate automotive certification of its core and interface IP. It completed the acquisition of Pixelworks Semiconductor (Shanghai) in January 2026 through its controlled vehicle Tiansui Xinyuan, which holds 100% of it, and consolidates it; the company says the deal strengthens its edge AI ASIC position and that it will combine distributed rendering with GPU for edge and cloud AI ASICs. It plans to consider acquisitions in Chiplet-related fields and companies with core semiconductor IP.

players.product: Semiconductor IP (interface / foundation IP) supplied to ASIC design houses under an IP OEM partnership (Gaonchips supplier)

contracts.signal: VeriSilicon's 2025 annual report states its semiconductor IP and EDA tool suppliers in 2025 were mainly Synopsys and Cadence, and lists both stopping their technology licences as a risk.
